about: E362 AG10: the most files a shard manifest's static closure (cold boot) may pull, from scripts/gen-shards.mjs manifestClosure. Recorded 2026-10-03; numbers may only fall. A new shard gets default (the template's size plus room for its data).

raised.driftwood-isle 271 → 272, nine-dragon-st: E417 (2026-10-03): the engine's one props file became the kit's props + models files; same code, one more module, because these manifests import the whole #kit index at cold boot (the real cost: ~200 kit files)
